title: MCQ Test Prep
blurb: Programming, DSA, CS fundamentals and logical-reasoning guides for MCQ screening rounds.

quiz.question: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements?
quiz.explanation: Each step halves the remaining range, so at most about log₂ n + 1 comparisons.

quiz.question: Which HTTP status code means the client is authenticated but not allowed to access the resource?
quiz.explanation: 401 actually means unauthenticated (missing or invalid credentials); 403 means authenticated but not authorized.

quiz.question: Which normal form removes transitive dependencies (non-key attributes depending on other non-key attributes)?
quiz.explanation: 1NF: atomic values; 2NF: no partial dependency on part of a composite key; 3NF: no transitive dependencies.

quiz.question: If 5 machines make 5 widgets in 5 minutes, how long do 100 machines take to make 100 widgets?
quiz.explanation: Each machine makes one widget in 5 minutes, so 100 machines make 100 widgets in the same 5 minutes.

quiz.question: Which OSI layer does TCP operate at?
quiz.explanation: TCP and UDP are transport-layer protocols; IP is the network layer.

problems.title: Trace the output
problems.prompt: int x = 5; System.out.println(x++ + ++x); — what is printed in Java?
problems.solution: 12. x++ yields 5 and makes x = 6; then ++x makes x = 7 and yields 7; 5 + 7 = 12.

problems.title: Time-and-work puzzle
problems.prompt: A can finish a job in 10 days and B in 15 days. Working together, how many days do they take?
problems.solution: Rates: A = 1/10, B = 1/15 job per day. Together: 1/10 + 1/15 = 3/30 + 2/30 = 1/6, so 6 days.
